item.title: REWIND - TTT 211: All Hands On Dick
item.description:
We’re taking a little break over Christmas and New Years because it gets crazy busy buying gifts, visiting friends and family, planning parties, baking stuff, eating stuff. You get the picture.

Enjoy this older episode from way back. Also, make sure to sign up for our newsletter. The form is at the bottom of this page and every other page on the website. It’s that easy.

The newsletter will come out every few weeks or so and will feature news, announcements, and special fan-only content not available anywhere else. Put down the chocolate Christmas treats and sign up today. Do it!
